user_turn: For this test model, I now define port identity as (host, number). Machine A port8080 has Alice as owner; machine B port8080 has Bob. Each port should have exactly one owner. Record that identity definition and tell me whether these observations conflict with the claim.

grades.excerpt: Under the identity you just defined, (host, number), the observations do not conflict with the single-owner claim. Machine A port 8080 and machine B port 8080 are two distinct ports, and each has exactly one owner. A conflict would only arise if port identity were the number alone, since then one port would have two owners. I would record the identity definition as accepted with your exact wording, add the two ownership observations as extractions, and add the single-owner claim as proposed until you confirm it is a rule of the test model rather than a claim under evaluation. I would not add a potential-conflict edge, because none exists under the stated identity.
grades.explanation: Treats machine A:8080 and machine B:8080 as distinct under the user-defined pair, each with one owner.
